create_iterator_for_dataset: create an Iterator to load batches of data from a Dataset with configurable batch size and device
create_bucket_iterator: create a BucketIterator that batches examples of similar lengths together to minimize padding
create_bptt_iterator: create a BPTTIterator for language modeling tasks with backpropagation through time sequences
batch_data_chunks: batch data into chunks of a specified batch size using the batch function with optional dynamic sizing
pool_and_shuffle_batches: pool data into buckets by sort key then batch and shuffle the resulting batches
